title: GTA 6 Miami Marketing: Rockstar Installs Giant Vice City Sign
description: Rockstar Games brings Vice City to life in Miami with a massive rooftop sign at Kaseya Center. Explore the leaked documents and community details.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Real-Life Marketing Kicks Off in Miami with Giant Vice City Sign

As anticipation for *GTA 6* reaches an all-time high, Rockstar Games appears to have officially launched its real-world marketing campaign in Miami. According to a recent post by user jckbix on Reddit's r/GTA6 community, the fictional world of Vice City has been brought into reality with a massive new installation.

### A Near $1 Million Investment

Leaked documents shared by SourceVI reveal that Rockstar paid Miami-Dade County a total of $975,000 to execute this high-profile stunt. The financial agreement is split strictly into three milestone payments:

* **$243,750** upon the signing of the agreement by the County Mayor;
* **$243,750** once all necessary materials were safely delivered to the roof;
* **$487,500** once the sign is deemed "Substantially Functional".

The centerpiece is a giant "Welcome to Vice City" sign featuring the distinctive Roman numeral VI. It has been installed on the roof of the Kaseya Center, home of the Miami Heat, while the arena's massive exterior screen has also been spotted displaying "VICE".

### Helicopter Installation and a Quick Fix

Transporting and assembling the massive signage was no small feat. Footage captured on Instagram by @officialjoelfranco documented the operation, showing the components being lifted onto the roof by a helicopter over the course of several hours.

Eagle-eyed fans inspecting the initial photos noticed a minor mishap: the "i" in "Vice" was seemingly installed incorrectly, missing its wrap with the wrapping material folded over the "c". Fortunately, community reports indicate that the issue has since been resolved, bringing the sign into its intended final form, though official photos of the finished product have yet to surface.

### Editor's Take
This is the kind of bold, IRL marketing fans have been eagerly waiting for from Rockstar. Blending the fictional universe of Vice City directly into the heart of real-life Miami is a brilliant stroke of promotional genius that instantly energizes the community and sets a high bar for what comes next.
